title: Chhaqhat Jaqinaka
intro: Mä comunidadan ecos ukanakap nayraqatan sayt’atätawa, jupanakan sarnaqäwipax oladanakan qillqt’atawa. Uka almanakax mä jawsäw ist’apxäna, jan yäqañ ajllipxäna, ukat mä consecuencia ukar saykatapxäna, ukax aka uraqiruw mayjt’ayäna. ¿Khitinakas jupanakaxa, ukat kunas jupanakan akapachapat pasäna?
clues: Nayratpachaw jakasipjjayäta, ukat mä yatiyiriw jiwasanak taypit jutäna.
Phisqa idolonakaruw yupaychapxta, janiw jaytañ munapkti.
Chiqpach arsuspa ukhax castigo apaniñapatakiw mayipxta.
Alaxpachan jallu purintatapa ukat uraqix uma jalsunak jalsur uñjapxta.
Qhispiñatakix jachʼa chiqanakaruw makatapxta, ukampis oladanakaw katjapxitu.

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
